rationale: The baseline checker accepted an input whose right half was copied from the left, so an incorrect right-half hypothesis exactly matched the labeled answer. The repaired grammar rejects that ambiguity while the Racket oracle still correctly executes the malformed grid.

rationale: EXAMPLES_NEEDED=2 is only meaningful if a two-example lesson rules out fixed-height/fixed-width memorization; adjacent dimension profiles therefore never repeat either height or half-width.
summary: Dimension cycles are arranged so every cyclic two-demo window varies both input height and crop width.
